zh.title: Frontier Airlines裁撤亞特蘭大21條航線
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines於亞特蘭大削減21條航線；調整網路佈局並保留長期發展目標
body: 根據航空媒體Simple Flying報導，Frontier Airlines正在削減其在亞特蘭大（ATL）的航線網路，並決定裁撤其中的21條航線。此項決定是在該公司於亞特蘭大經歷快速擴線之後所推行。
Frontier Airlines本次調整主要是梳理其在亞特蘭大的營運網路，並針對表現較為弱勢的航線進行裁撤，以修正先前快速擴展後的航線佈局。
儘管縮減了亞特蘭大多條航線，Frontier Airlines仍將維持其在該機場的長遠發展規劃，並保留其在亞特蘭大的長期發展目標。

en.title: Frontier Airlines Cuts 21 Routes From Atl (ATL)anta Network
en.summary: Frontier Airlines cuts 21 routes from Atlanta; network pruned while preserving long-term goals.
body: According to reporting from Simple Flying, Frontier Airlines is cutting 21 routes from its network at Atlanta . The decision to prune these services follows a period of rapid network expansion by the carrier at the airport.

Frontier Airlines is adjusting its operations in Atlanta  by eliminating underperforming and weak routes from its schedule. The reduction allows the airline to streamline its local route structure following the previous rapid growth phase.

Despite the decision to eliminate 21 routes from its Atlanta  network, Frontier Airlines is preserving its long-term ambitions at the airport. The carrier plans to maintain its ongoing strategic presence at the hub while optimizing its flight offerings.

zh.title: Electra 測試 ultra-STOL 飛機 作為 feeder
zh.summary: Electra 於 2026 年 8 月 18 日宣布進行 ultra-STOL 混合電動飛機示範飛行，測試作為主要機場（PHL） feeder 的能力；飛行計畫在 FAA eIPP 支持下，從維吉尼亞州 Manassas 出發，最後停靠費城國際機場（PNE），途中曾停靠紐澤西州的 Millville Executive 和 Atlantic City Bader Field 以及賓夕法尼亞州的 Northeast Philadelphia Airport。
body: Electra，一家開發 ultra-short takeoff and landing (STOL) 混合電動飛機的新創公司，於 2026 年 8 月 18 日宣布已完成一系列示範飛行，以驗證該新型飛機作為主要機場 feeder 的能力。
飛行計畫在 eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) 的框架下進行，該計畫得到美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 的支持，同時也獲得賓夕法尼亞州交通部 (PennDOT) 與新澤西州交通部 (NJDOT) 的協助。

飛行自 Electra 在維吉尼亞州 Manassas 的基地出發，最終抵達賓夕法尼亞州的 Philadelphia International Airport 。途中，Electra 的「Goldfinch」示範機分別停靠了紐澤西州的 Millville Executive Airport (MIV) 與 Atlantic City Bader Field (AIY)，以及賓夕法尼亞州的 Northeast Philadelphia Airport 。
該項目的關鍵目標之一是測試小型混合電動飛機（如 Electra 的機型）在美國國家空域管理系統中服務多個小型、使用率不高的機場，以提升空間網路的毛細血管功能。

Electra 首席執行官 Marc Allen 在新聞稿中表示：「Electra’s Ultra Short aircraft can create direct connections between communities, regional airports, and major hubs, unlocking a faster, more accessible way to travel。」
除了此項目外，Electra 尚有其他正在進行的示範飛行計畫，包括與佛羅里達州交通部及私營合作夥伴的合作、與 Signature Aviation 和 Vertiports by Atlantic 測試其 ultra-STOL 飛機在紐約／新澤西地區直升機場的適用性，以及與 Bristow Group 在路易斯安那州的另一項測試計畫。

en.title: Electra tests ultra-STOL aircraft as feeder for major airports
en.summary: Electra announced on August 18, 2026 that it conducted demonstration flights of its ultra-short takeoff and landing (STOL) hybrid-electric aircraft to test feasibility as a feeder for major airports; the program was run under the FAA-backed eVTOL Integration Pilot Program, with support from PennDOT and NJDOT, flying from Manassas, Virginia to Philadelphia International Airport (PNE) (PHL)                                                                 with stops at Millville Executive (MIV), Atlantic City Bader Field (AIY) and Northeast Philadelphia .
body: Electra, a startup developing an ultra-short takeoff and landing (STOL) hybrid-electric aircraft, announced on August 18, 2026 that it has conducted a series of demonstration flights testing the capability of this novel aircraft to operate as a feeder for major airports.

The flight program took place under the aegis of the eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP), backed by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), and also saw support from the Department of Transportation of two states: Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
The flight program began at Electra’s base in Manassas, Virginia and made its final stop at Philadelphia International Airport , Pennsylvania.

Along the way, Electra’s “Goldfinch” demonstrator stopped at several small regional airports: Millville Executive Airport                                             and Atlantic City Bader Field (AIY), both in New Jersey, and Northeast Philadelphia Airport , Pennsylvania.

One of the key aims of the project was to test the integration of small hybrid-electric aircraft like Electra’s, which is designed to provide air network capillarity by servicing multiple small, underused airfields in the US national airspace management system.

“Electra’s Ultra Short aircraft can create direct connections between communities, regional airports, and major hubs, unlocking a faster, more accessible way to travel,” said Marc Allen, Electra’s CEO, in a press release announcing the milestone.

In parallel to this initiative, Electra currently has other projects underway to test its technology in real operational conditions, including a demonstration flight program in Florida with that state’s Department of Transportation and private-sector partners, a project with Signature Aviation and Vertiports by Atlantic to assess suitability of its ultra-STOL aircraft for heliport operations in the New York/New Jersey area, and another testing program in Louisiana together with Bristow Group.

zh.title: 美國法院延後審理Google收購Spirit Airlines資料案 工會提出異議
zh.summary: 路透社報導，美國法院延後Google收購Spirit Airlines內部資料的聽證會；工會對交易提出異議
body: 路透社報導，美國法院延後了針對Google收購Spirit Airlines內部資料案的聽證會，原因是有工會對該交易提出異議。
根據先前公開的法院文件，Google在破產拍賣中以1000萬美元標得Spirit Airlines的內部業務資料，資料涵蓋超過76萬3000架次航班的營運數據，但乘客與常旅客資料被明確排除在外。
該交易原須經美國破產法官批准，聽證會原定於8月19日在紐約南區美國破產法院舉行。目前聽證會已遭延後，後續審理時程尚待確認。

en.title: US Court Delays Hearing on Google's Purchase of Spirit Airlines Data as Union Objects
en.summary: Reuters: US court delays hearing on Google's acquisition of Spirit Airlines internal data; a union has objected to the transaction
body: Reuters reports that a US court has delayed a hearing on Google's purchase of Spirit Airlines' internal business data after a union objected to the transaction.

According to previously disclosed court filings, Google won a bankruptcy auction to acquire Spirit Airlines' internal business data for $10 million. The dataset includes operational data covering more than 763,000 flights, while passenger and frequent flyer data are explicitly excluded.

The transaction remains subject to approval by a US bankruptcy judge, with the hearing originally scheduled for 19 August in the US Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York. The hearing has now been delayed, and a rescheduled date has not yet been confirmed.
